  "explanation": <one sentence>}

Case: Viet is a 35-year-old who presents to your emergency room with complaints of severe abdominal and pelvic pain. Viet describes the pain as sudden in onset and started shortly after a heavy dinner the night prior. Viet's pain is worst in the left lower quadrant of his abdomen, and on examination he is tender to palpation of this area with some guarding and rebound tenderness. Viet is mildly tachycardic, but otherwise has normal vital signs and is afebrile.
